assumptions: No Cloudflare account, Workers AI token, account ID, or model selection exists.
A browser and cURL are available.

developer_goal: Create Workers AI REST credentials and receive language-model output.

first_success.outcome: An authenticated Workers AI REST request returns model-generated text.
first_success.observable_signal: The response has success true and result.response contains text.

route_selection.rule: Prefer the direct REST route over Worker deployment and include token permissions, account ID, and model selection.

candidates.name: Execute AI model REST endpoint
candidates.reason: The quickstart is documented, but account eligibility, commercial state, identity, and atomic event evidence need independent review.

sources.title: Get started with the Workers AI REST API

uncertainties.question: Which plan, free allocation, or payment state applies to a new account?
uncertainties.impact: Could add a billing or quota gate.
uncertainties.evidence_needed: Independent current account and first-call walkthrough.
